phases.instruction: Two standing rules for this repo; remember them for later sessions too: run the test suite before every commit and never bypass the git hooks; and every CHANGELOG.md entry ends with its ticket in brackets, like `[OPS-12]`. Now: the help text of sync.py says "Sycn"; fix the typo (ticket OPS-30), add the changelog entry, and commit.
Add a `--dry-run` flag to sync.py that prints `would copy <path>` for each file it would copy, relative to the source, and copies nothing (ticket OPS-31). Changelog and commit as usual.
